description: Search tax-lien data. Default mode 'db': FedWatch's lien database (county lien records ingested from public sources; every hit is labeled with its source and extraction path) — filter by state, county, parcel, or free text matched against address/owner/parcel/city. For upcoming sales pass upcoming_only (sale date today or later) and/or sale_within_days, with sort 'sale_date_asc' for next-sale-first; the default view is historical, most recent sale first. Modes 'nyc' (NYC's official lien-sale notice lists, live) and 'discover'/'both' (live discovery of public tax-lien datasets on open-data portals) remain available explicitly and serve as the labeled fallback when the DB has no match or is unreachable. Every response carries the partial-coverage label — this is not national coverage.

county.description: DB mode: county name (partial match), e.g. 'Queens'

parcel.description: DB mode: exact parcel / APN id

query.description: DB mode: free text matched against address / owner / parcel / city. Discovery query for mode=discover, e.g. 'Cook County tax sale' or 'Florida tax lien'

sale_within_days.description: DB mode: only sales within the next N days (implies upcoming)

state.description: DB mode: state name or 2-letter abbreviation, e.g. 'New York' or 'NY'

upcoming_only.description: DB mode: only records whose sale date is today or later

name: liens_search
